description: Telebirr is Ethio Telecom's mobile money service and the most widely used digital wallet in Ethiopia. Telebirr receipts are published as public HTML pages accessible via a URL containing only the transaction reference number. The endpoint is geo-blocked to Ethiopian IP addresses.

faq.q: What does a Telebirr reference number look like?
faq.a: Telebirr transaction references start with a 2-3 letter prefix followed by 6-8 alphanumeric characters. Common prefixes include DET, CHQ, DAB, DEL, and ADQ. The full reference is sent via SMS to both payer and receiver after each transaction.

faq.q: Can I scan the QR code on a Telebirr receipt?
faq.a: Yes. Scan or upload the Payment QR Code on the Telebirr receipt and cheki reads the transaction number out of it, then checks that number with Telebirr exactly as if you had typed it. The QR only contains the transaction number (no amount or names), so it is not proof of payment on its own: only Telebirr's receipt record confirms a payment.

faq.q: Why does Telebirr verification fail from outside Ethiopia?
faq.a: Telebirr's receipt endpoint (transactioninfo.ethiotelecom.et) blocks requests from IP addresses outside Ethiopia. This is a network-level restriction. cheki provides a fallback URL so users on Ethiopian networks can open the receipt directly in their browser.

faq.q: Can I self-host cheki for Telebirr verification?
faq.a: Yes. Running cheki on a server with an Ethiopian IP address (or using X-Forwarded-For with an Ethiopian IP from a residential connection) bypasses the geo-block. See the Docker self-hosting guide in the GitHub repository.

faq.q: Is Telebirr receipt verification free?
faq.a: Yes. The Telebirr receipt URL is public and returns an HTML page with transaction details. check.et and verify.et charge you for fetching this same URL. cheki does it for free.

name: Bank of Abyssinia
description: Bank of Abyssinia (BOA) is one of Ethiopia's largest private banks. BOA publishes receipt data as JSON via a public API endpoint that requires the transaction reference and the last 5 digits of the account on the receipt. A full BOA slip link (cs.bankofabyssinia.com/slip/?trx=...) can carry both: cheki splits the reference and the 5 digits out of it. For inter-bank transfers (BOA to CBE, Dashen, etc.), the receipt QR code is AES-256-CBC encrypted: cheki decrypts it to read the reference and receiving account, then confirms the receipt with BOA. If BOA cannot be reached, the result is marked as decoded from the QR and not confirmed. No Selenium or headless browser required.
referenceFormat: Alphanumeric reference starting with 2 letters (varies by transaction type). Inter-bank transfers use FT references (e.g., FT25SAMPLE06).
howToVerify: For BOA-to-BOA receipts: paste the BOA slip link, or enter the transaction reference and the last 5 digits of the account on the receipt
cheki calls BOA's public JSON API and returns structured payment data in 1-2 seconds
For inter-bank transfers (BOA to CBE/Dashen/etc.): scan the QR code on the receipt with cheki's camera scanner or upload a screenshot

cheki auto-detects BOA QR payloads and decrypts them server-side: the QR supplies the reference and receiving account, and BOA confirms the receipt. No account number to type. If BOA cannot be reached, the result is shown as decoded only, not verified.
useCases: Merchants verifying BOA transfers at checkout
Businesses reconciling BOA deposits
Verifying inter-bank transfers (BOA to CBE, Dashen, etc.) via QR code decryption
Apps integrating BOA payment verification with QR code support
Finance teams auditing BOA transactions

faq.q: Does BOA verification require Selenium or a headless browser?
faq.a: No. Unlike the ethiobank_receipts library which requires Chrome WebDriver for BOA, cheki uses BOA's JSON API directly. This is faster, lighter, and works in serverless environments without browser dependencies.

faq.q: What information do I need to verify a BOA transaction?
faq.a: For BOA-to-BOA receipts, paste the BOA slip link; when it carries the 5 account digits after the reference, nothing else is needed. Otherwise, enter the transaction reference and the last 5 digits of the account on the receipt. For inter-bank transfers (BOA to CBE, Dashen, etc.), scan the QR code on the receipt. No account number is needed for QR-based verification.

faq.q: Can I verify inter-bank BOA transfers (sent to CBE or other banks)?
faq.a: Yes, but only via QR code. BOA's JSON API returns 'Invalid reference number' for inter-bank transfers (FT references). Scan the QR code on the receipt: cheki decrypts it (AES-256-CBC) to read the reference and receiving account, then confirms the receipt with BOA. If BOA cannot be reached, the result is marked as decoded only, not verified. See our BOA QR code guide for the technical breakdown.

faq.q: How does BOA QR code verification work?
faq.a: BOA receipt QR codes contain the transaction data encrypted with AES-256-CBC using CryptoJS format. The encryption key is embedded in BOA's public receipt web app. cheki decrypts the QR payload server-side and returns structured JSON with sender, receiver, amount, date, and reference. See our BOA QR code breakdown for full details.

faq.q: Is the BOA receipt endpoint public?
faq.a: Yes. The BOA online slip API at cs.bankofabyssinia.com is publicly accessible without authentication. check.et and verify.et charge you for calling this same endpoint.

faq.q: Is BOA QR code verification secure?
faq.a: The AES key is public in BOA's web app JavaScript, so anyone can decrypt (and theoretically forge) QR codes. For high-value inter-bank transfers, request additional confirmation like a bank statement or SMS alert. See our BOA QR code guide for the full security analysis.

name: Awash Bank
notes: URL fully reverse engineered with 18 samples (Apr 2025-Jun 2026). URL format: -{base36(txID)}-{base36(counter)}. txID has YYMMDDHHMM+5-digit-seq structure (2026+). Counter is monotonically increasing with accelerating rate (4.4/sec in 2025 to 7.5/sec in Jun 2026). Share link sent via SMS automatically. 2 successful brute-force proofs (May 14, Apr 1). Backend: MoonlightMBanking (Java) behind F5 BIG-IP WAF. Need more samples from underrepresented periods.
description: Awash Bank publishes transaction receipts as public HTML pages on awashpay.awashbank.com. The share link has a two-part token: the first part is the numeric Transaction ID encoded in base-36, and the second part is a server-side counter that increases with transaction time. The link is sent automatically via SMS after every transaction. You can also share it from the Awash app.
referenceFormat: Awash share link from SMS (e.g. https://awashpay.awashbank.com:8225/-2KDL95XE81-4U0000). The first segment is base-36 of the Transaction ID; the second segment is a server counter.
howToVerify: Find the receipt link in your Awash SMS message (sent automatically after every transaction)
Or open the Awash app and share the receipt as a link
Paste the full share link (https://awashpay.awashbank.com:8225/-...) into cheki
cheki fetches the official receipt and extracts the payment details
useCases: Merchants verifying Awash transfers
Businesses reconciling Awash deposits
Apps integrating Awash payment verification

faq.q: Why doesn't the visible Transaction ID work?
faq.a: Awash receipt URLs require a two-part share token. The first part is the numeric Transaction ID encoded in base-36 (e.g. 260607112200001 becomes 2KDL95XE81). The second part is a server-side counter that validates the share. Use the share link generated by the Awash app.

faq.q: Where is the share link in the Awash app?
faq.a: After a transfer, open the transaction details in the Awash app and use the share option. The link will look like https://awashpay.awashbank.com:8225/-XXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXX.

faq.q: Can cheki generate the share link from the Transaction ID?
faq.a: We have proven it is possible. By converting the Transaction ID to base-36 (part 1) and brute-forcing the counter (part 2) around a time-based prediction, we successfully constructed valid share URLs from just the Transaction ID twice. With 18 samples spanning April 2025 to June 2026, our prediction model is accurate enough for nearby dates. With more community samples, brute-force time could drop to under 1 minute.

faq.q: Is the second part of the Awash URL random?
faq.a: It is a monotonically increasing counter, not random. From 18 analyzed samples, the counter rate is accelerating: 4.4/sec in mid-2025, 6.4/sec by January 2026, and 7.5/sec by June 2026. A quadratic model fits with R-squared = 0.9999. The share link is sent automatically via SMS after every transaction.

faq.q: What is the Transaction ID structure?
faq.a: Since 2026, the Transaction ID has a fixed format: YYMMDDHHMM followed by a 5-digit per-minute sequence number. For example, 260607112200001 means 2026-06-07 at 11:22, sequence 00001 within that minute. Transactions before 2026 use a different hex-like format. The transaction date and time are encoded directly in the Transaction ID.

faq.q: Where do I find the share link?
faq.a: Awash Bank sends the receipt link automatically via SMS after every transaction. Look for a message starting with 'Dear Customer' containing a link to awashpay.awashbank.com:8225. You can also share the receipt from the AwashBirr Pro app.

faq.q: Which banks does eBirr cover?

faq.q: How do I find my eBirr receipt URL?
faq.a: Open the eBirr app, go to your transaction history, tap the transaction, and use the share button. The shared link will be in the format receipt.ebirr.com/{tenant}/{token}. You can paste this full URL or just the tenant/token part into cheki.

faq.q: Is eBirr different from Telebirr?
faq.a: Yes. Telebirr is Ethio Telecom's mobile wallet. eBirr is a separate mobile money platform operated by eBirr Inc. that partners with multiple banks. They are completely different services with different receipt endpoints.

faq.q: Is the eBirr receipt endpoint public?
faq.a: Yes. The receipt URL at receipt.ebirr.com/{tenant}/{token} is publicly accessible without authentication. The token is a random string that maps to a specific transaction. cheki, qbirr, and any other verification service use this same endpoint.

description: ZamZam Bank is an Islamic bank established in 2021. Its receipt links (receipt.zamzambank.com.et/receipt/...) are backed by a JSON service: cheki looks the receipt id up there and confirms that ZamZam has the record, with its amount, date and the ZamZam account holder (account number masked). useCases: Merchants confirming a ZamZam Bank transfer before releasing goods

faq.q: What does cheki confirm for a ZamZam Bank receipt?
faq.a: That ZamZam Bank's receipt service has a record for that receipt id, and what the record says: the amount, the date (ZamZam gives no time) and the ZamZam account holder's name with a masked account number. When ZamZam names the other side, cheki shows it too. Compare these with the payment you expected. ZamZam support is in beta: whether the account holder paid or received is inferred from the record's debit/credit flag.

faq.q: What do I need to verify a ZamZam Bank receipt?
faq.a: The receipt link from the ZamZam app (https://receipt.zamzambank.com.et/receipt/...) or the number at the end of it. No account number is needed. The transaction reference printed on the receipt does not work on its own.

faq.q: Does cheki show the full ZamZam account number?
faq.a: No. ZamZam's record carries the full account number; cheki masks it to the first digit and the last 4 before showing, returning or caching anything.

faq.q: Is the ZamZam receipt endpoint public?
faq.a: The receipt page is public. Its data comes from a ZamZam service that expects a fixed credential which ZamZam ships inside its public receipt web app, so every visitor's browser sends it. cheki sends the same credential. No customer login is involved.

seo.title: ZamZam Bank Receipt Check: Verify ZamZam Payments

formats.label: Receipt link or receipt id
formats.evidence: cheki, 2026-10-12: the receipt page's web app (receipt.zamzambank.com.et/assets/index-*.js) fetches receipt-backend.zamzambank.com.et/api/v1/invoice/{id} with a hardcoded HTTP Basic credential. Without it the endpoint answers 401; an unknown id answers HTTP 200 with the body null; a real receipt answered a JSON object (name, reference, id, amount, vat, dt, acc_NUM, drcr, other_NAME, trn_DESCRIPTION, currency, code) in about 2 seconds. Another verifier also lists receipt.zamzambank.com.et (JSON).
formats.notes: Party sides are inferred from drcr (D: the account holder paid; C: received). One receipt shape checked so far.
